atlasDraft.pZh: 木板接缝旁，铜扣留着。渡人把它移到秤盘上，指针没有偏。他在簿页写下一个空格，墨水停在格外。
atlasDraft.pEn: The brass button remained beside the plank seam. The ferryman moved it to the scale; the needle did not shift. In the ledger he left a blank. The ink stopped at its edge.
atlasDraft.codaEn: The plank did not record the blank.
